title: The Storm Changes the Grammar: The Verse That Stops Calling You "You" the Moment the Sea Turns Rough
excerpt: In Yunus 10:22, God begins by addressing you directly ('He carries you across land and sea'), then shifts to third person exactly when the fair wind blows ('they sailed with them... they rejoiced'), and only returns to 'You' inside the drowning prayer. Al-Jalalayn names the turn: an iltifat, a deliberate shift of person mid-verse.
seo_title: The Iltifat in Quran 10:22: When the Grammar Turns From 'You' to 'Them'
seo_description: Quran 10:22 opens addressing 'you,' shifts to 'them' the moment the ship sails on a fair wind, and returns to 'You' only in the storm prayer. Al-Jalalayn names it an iltifat. A corpus-verified reading of pronoun-shift in Surah Yunus.
